figuren.name: Hauptmann Rechtfertig

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout position only; not a safe fixed512crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: MALE-READ ROBBER CAPTAIN, grand grievance and wounded pride. Tall broad pear blob with one hooked crown loop, battered dark charcoal wide-brim SLOUCH HAT, one short rusty-red scarf and small dull brass clasp. Cold furious self-command: one white eye narrowed and other wider, brows extremely unequal, clenched crooked teeth in a shallow sideways mouth, huge heavy lower lip. Holds ONE SHORT OLD FLINTLOCK PISTOL with thick wooden grip and single dull steel barrel upright close beside own body, pointing upward within own cell, other hand grips the end of own scarf. No aiming at anyone or heroic human uniform.

Compact wavy-edged pear splat, two short dark clay side curls, small worn ochre bonnet pushed behind face and a torn ivory cuff at one goo wrist. Very sly hostile amusement: one huge white eye looks SIDEWAYS, opposite eye almost squints, one arched brow and a near-closed lopsided smile with one irregular upper fang. Holds ONE fat worn LEATHER COIN PURSE clasped low at belly; other hand draws ONE oversized brass KEY halfway from the purse. No jewellery pile or theft gesture toward another actor. Face completely uncovered.

figuren.prompt_auszug: MALE-READ LOOT KEEPER / TREACHEROUS FENCE. Broad squat diamond-like soft splat with short rumpled clay side hair, battered dark red merchant cap and one muted brown checked shoulder scrap. Deep greedy distrust, heavy white eyes look SIDEWAYS in different squints, one eyebrow curled higher, almost CLOSED sneering lip with two small widely spaced teeth. Both hands protect ONE small thick WOODEN CASH BOX with hinged lid slightly open; exactly THREE large GOLD COINS visible inside, no scattered loot. His grip is much more frightened than his expression admits.
